    Initialize a targets project

    tar_init.Rd

    Initialize a targets project

    tar_init(
  home = ".",
  phase_names = c("fetch", "process", "summarize"),
  phase_nums = seq_along(phase_names),
  separate_phase_scripts = TRUE,
  phase_subdirs = c("src", "out"),
  overwrite = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    home

    char, root directory of targets project. Defaults to current working directory

    phase_names

    char vector, names of target phases

    phase_nums

    int vector, numbers to prepend to phase_names like "1_fetch", "2_process", etc. Defaults to 1:length(phase_names)

    separate_phase_scripts

    lgl, should a different R script be created for each phase like "1_fetch.R", "2_process.R", etc? If FALSE, then targets lists will be initialized in _targets.R file

    phase_subdirs

    char vector, subdirectories within each phase like "src", "out"

    overwrite

    lgl, should the initialization overwrite files and folders that already exist?

    Value

    NULL invisibly
